neighbours.label: ' matter' in concessive 'no matter how / what ...' (also ' and' joining a whether-clause to an extent question: 'whether ... and how much')
fire: The fee stays the same no matter how many bags you bring.
She kept smiling no matter how tired she felt.
The warranty covers the engine no matter how far you drive.
He was never satisfied, no matter how much money he earned.
The door would not open no matter how hard we pushed.
The rule applies to every member, no matter how long they have belonged.
The soup tasted bland no matter how much salt I added.
Children should feel safe at school no matter how young they are.
quiet: The fee stays the same for however many bags you bring.
She kept smiling even though she felt tired.
The warranty covers the engine regardless of how far you drive.
He was never satisfied, although he earned a lot of money.
It was only a matter of minutes before the door opened.
It doesn't matter to the club how long a member has belonged.
The soup tasted bland even after I added more salt.
The matter of school safety was raised at the meeting.

notes: Probes: 'no matter how old/many' 0.42-0.47, 'no matter what' 0.21; 'It doesn't matter how' 0.01, 'a matter of time' 0.01, 'Regardless of how' 0.00. Second trigger not tested here: 'whether ... and how much / and the extent of' 0.37-0.44. Card tops also include Chinese/Russian tokens before a quantity ('...船员人数', 'и в каком объеме'), so the shared pattern may be 'an extent or amount question follows'.
